# Analyze Building Footprints

Load example data in the package

```{r eval=FALSE}
data(globfp_example)
```

## Morphologic properties and indices

```{r eval=FALSE}
result <- gloBFPr::get_morphology(globfp_example)
```

## Population density

```{r eval=FALSE}
result <- gloBFPr::get_pop_density(result)
```

## Neighboring buildings

```{r eval=FALSE}
result <- gloBFPr::get_neighbors(result, radius = 500)
```

## Greenery aaccessibility

```{r eval=FALSE}
result <- gloBFPr::get_green_acc(result, 
                                 min_tree_height = 2, 
                                 radius = 800,
                                 key = '')
```
